environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) deployed with a Lambda Function URL. The function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. A resource-based policy on the function specifies a Condition block requiring 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' to equal 'AWS_IAM' and the principal must match an internal service role ARN (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/internal-processor-role). The function URL endpoint returns HTTP 403 '{"Message":"Forbidden"}' for any request that does not include a valid SigV4 signature from an authorized IAM principal. Note: the underlying code vulnerability still exists but the attack surface requires authenticated access from a specific IAM role that is bound by a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/NoLambdaInvokeBoundary) preventing direct invocation except through the approved Step Functions state machine.
